basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a high-fidelity, buildable French website mockup for Silicium, the existing distributed-computing platform.
LATEST USER DIRECTION, PRIORITY: previous concepts were much too visually busy. This revision must be dramatically quieter, more spacious, and more readable while retaining subtle glass/gloss/relief. Do not repeat the heavy all-over blue glass aesthetic.
Art direction: 90–95% quiet pearl-white/off-white background (#f7f9fc), deep navy typography, tiny restrained blue accents. Almost no visible background texture; at most one very pale soft light field behind the hero. Frosted glass used only for navigation, one featured functional surface, and selected controls. Fine pale borders, soft short shadows, a slim top highlight; primary blue buttons have gentle convex relief. Other content sits directly on the page with generous whitespace and thin separators. NOT a grid of equally prominent shiny cards. At most ONE modest illustration or actual product preview per page. Small consistent line icons instead of 3D art on every item. No chrome blobs, swirling light, dramatic refractions, luminous connector spaghetti, stacked decorative frames, giant badges or invented statistics.
Typography: crisp Geist-like sans serif, dark navy titles, comfortable secondary text; restrained scale, 16px body minimum, strong hierarchy. Desktop section gaps approximately 96px and clear 24–32px internal spacing. Keep the material tactile at close inspection without competing with content.
Brand reference: the supplied image is the NEW authentic Silicium logo from Downloads. It is a pale ice-blue glass diamond with raised 'Si' and layered rounded square backing. Preserve this exact image and its orientation, material and lettering, do not redesign it. Use it as a small 40px brand mark beside a dark navy 'Silicium' wordmark. White logo background blends with the quiet page.
Output: straight-on usable website screenshot-style mockup, edge-to-edge page, no device frame, no perspective, no browser chrome or watermark. French text. No fictional integrations, prices, performance claims, testimonials or feature promises. If numbers or sample projects appear, a discreet small artifact note says 'Maquette · données d’exemple'. Design data are examples, not live measurements.
Do not increase density to cram everything into view. Prioritize white space and readable UI. All page-specific decorative requests below are subordinate to this calm art direction; reduce them to ONE visual only.
publicShell: PUBLIC SHELL: very restrained wide glass navigation on an almost-white page. New pale glass Si logo at left with dark 'Silicium'. Links 'Produit', 'Installer', 'Blockchain', 'À propos', 'Contact', compact FR selector, a quiet 'Se connecter' and one modest raised blue 'Lancer un calcul'. No thick glowing nav frame. 1440px desktop viewport, 1160px centered content. Airy simple footer with thin top border, three short columns and experimental-project note.
appShell: APP SHELL: a calm 1440px desktop application. Slim 216px pearl-white frosted sidebar, original NEW pale-glass Si logo with navy Silicium wordmark. Sidebar items 'Vue d’ensemble', 'Mes projets', 'Mes machines', 'Types de calcul', 'Installer le nœud', 'État du réseau'; profile at bottom. Active item has a very subtle light-blue inset background and a short blue edge. Top bar is quiet with breadcrumb, FR, refresh and small avatar. Background almost white. No large dark sidebar, no all-over blue gradients. Main useful content uses mostly plain rows and one or two glass groups, accessible contrast and generous spacing.

pages.title: Accueil
pages.content:
A full-page desktop homepage on a tall portrait canvas, 1440px viewport. VERY AIRY and substantially calmer than conventional glassmorphism. Clear restrained navigation with the supplied NEW glass Si logo.
Hero: left eyebrow 'Le calcul distribué, accessible', dark navy headline 'Vos calculs, à une autre échelle.', two-line description 'Rendez une scène 3D, explorez vos documents ou traitez vos données par lot.' Primary 'Lancer un calcul' and quiet secondary 'Explorer les usages'. Small understated text link 'Faire participer ma machine'. Right: ONE elegant functional glass result-preview panel, showing a simple raytracer example with one reflective sphere and one blue cube on a neutral plane, small file tab 'image.png', status 'Exemple de résultat'. No extra network sculpture or floating mini dashboards.
After a large whitespace gap, a very thin status row 'État du réseau · À actualiser' and link 'Voir l’état'.
Section 'Quatre usages, un seul espace.' Present four clean rows or an open 2×2 text grid WITHOUT framed shiny cards or large images. Small consistent line icons. 'Rendu 3D' / 'Une scène en entrée, une image PNG en sortie.'; 'Recherche documentaire' / 'Retrouvez les passages utiles de vos documents.'; 'Traitement par IA' / 'Classez, résumez ou extrayez vos textes.'; 'Intégrité SHA-256' / 'Comparez les empreintes des parties de vos fichiers.' Each has a quiet small arrow link.
Then a generous section 'Du projet au résultat.' with four simple small numbered stages along a fine line: 'Préparer', 'Répartir', 'Vérifier', 'Récupérer'. No cards or diagrams around each stage.
One restrained navy-glass contribution band 'Votre machine peut faire partie du réseau.' and blue 'Installer Silicium Node', small 'APT · DNF · Windows'; no additional decorative sculpture.
Three concise FAQ rows, then a simple airy footer. The page must feel spacious, deliberate and understated while the main preview and controls still show subtle glass and tactile relief. No cloud background, no glowing network diagram, no extra glossy objects.

pages.title: Produit
pages.content: Full-page desktop product page. Hero 'Du fichier au résultat, gardez le fil.' with a compact description and 'Créer un projet'. A large interactive-looking glass process panel shows four numbered stages 'Préparer', 'Répartir', 'Vérifier', 'Assembler' and a 3D image being calculated in tiles. A quieter caption 'Illustration du fonctionnement'. Below, four useful short explanatory sections: supported inputs, work distribution, checks adapted to workload, results available in your space. Add a practical panel 'Ce que vous pouvez envoyer' containing four types and actual formats '.cfg', 'PDF / DOCX / TXT', 'CSV / JSONL', 'Fichier à analyser'. An 'État des services' panel uses statuses 'À actualiser' rather than fabricated operational claims: API, réseau, traçabilité. The final CTA offers 'Lancer un calcul' and 'Installer le nœud'. Keep a strong visual progression and fewer generic cards.

pages.title: Installation stable
pages.content: Full-page desktop installation hub, make this page especially practical. Heading 'Installez une fois. Participez au réseau.' Short explanation 'Installez Silicium Node et gardez-le à jour avec votre gestionnaire de paquets.' Raised segmented controls 'Linux' selected / 'Windows', then 'Stable' selected / 'Développement'. A large frosted installer panel has distribution tabs 'Debian / Ubuntu · APT' selected and 'Fedora / RHEL · DNF'. Inside, step 01 'Ajouter le dépôt' with readable dark navy code surface, monospace text and separate 'Copier' button. Exact representative APT lines: 'sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings', 'curl -fsSL https://vps-910c1dbc.vps.ovh.net/downloads/apt/silicium-packages.asc', then a clearly visible second step 'Installer le nœud' with exact 'sudo apt update' and 'sudo apt install silicium-node'. Keep the full real source command available conceptually; do not invent shorter insecure instructions. Show an adjacent concise DNF quick preview with exact 'sudo dnf makecache' and 'sudo dnf install silicium-node'. A supporting sidebar shows 'Dépôt stable', 'Paquets signés', 'Mises à jour via APT / DNF'. Section 'Pour les prochaines mises à jour' with command copy; Windows alternative below, not a Linux .deb/.rpm button. Finish 'Ouvrez l’application → Connectez votre machine → Suivez sa participation'. Shell command snippets should be large enough to read, no horizontal overflow.

pages.title: À propos
pages.content: Full-page desktop about page. Strong editorial hero 'Le calcul se partage.' with paragraph 'Silicium relie des projets à des machines participantes pour exécuter des calculs compatibles et réunir leurs résultats.' Beside it a sculptural cluster of layered blue glass tiles with subtle connecting lines. Explain project purpose with a readable editorial text section 'Construire un réseau utile et compréhensible.' Then a visually clear four-role architecture strip: 'Coordonner', 'Calculer', 'Vérifier', 'Assembler', with restrained tactile icons. Three principles 'Des usages concrets', 'Une exécution visible', 'Une participation accessible'. Include small honest line 'Projet expérimental de calcul distribué'. Final actions 'Découvrir le fonctionnement' and 'Participer au réseau'. No fabricated team, client logos, adoption metrics or environmental claims.

pages.title: Blockchain
pages.content: Full-page desktop traceability page. Hero heading 'Le résultat compte. Son parcours aussi.' with short copy 'Consultez les traces disponibles de vos opérations sur Solana.' Paired with a beautiful but practical glass ledger diagram: 'Projet → Exécution → Vérification → Trace', with abstract transaction identifiers clearly labeled 'Exemple de trace'. CTA 'Associer mon portefeuille' and secondary 'Comprendre le parcours'. A highly legible callout 'Vos fichiers ne sont pas inscrits sur la blockchain.' Explain computing and verification happen in the network; chain is for operation traceability. Timeline below shows the four stages without invented guarantees or balances. Wallet panel with original existing supported provider 'Phantom', connect state 'Non associé' and 'Ouvrir mon profil'. Subtle status panel 'Configuration de la traçabilité : à actualiser', avoid claiming payments or mainnet availability. Navy glass accent section, pale blue surroundings, strong readable contrast.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content: Desktop full-page contact UI, landscape 3:2 canvas. Title 'Une idée pour Silicium ?' Description 'Proposez un usage, partagez un retour ou suggérez une amélioration.' Two-column composition: generous editorial left with a small glass message sculpture and useful text; right a polished frosted form. Fields 'Nom', 'Adresse e-mail', 'Sujet', 'Votre idée', all proper labels above inset inputs, clear focus styling on one field. Button 'Envoyer mon idée'. Clear concise helper 'Pour lancer un calcul, utilisez votre espace.' link 'Créer un projet'. Form is specifically ideas/feedback, no fake support SLA, telephone number, address or public sales team. Include visible footer; high-quality light glass surfaces and blue raised submit button.

pages.title: Connexion
pages.content: Desktop authentication login screen. Wide airy split composition: left original Si logo and headline 'Un espace pour vos calculs.' with three concise benefits 'Préparez vos projets', 'Suivez leur exécution', 'Retrouvez vos résultats' alongside an abstract coherent glass compute sculpture. Right a clear frosted floating form, title 'Content de vous retrouver', small text 'Connectez-vous à votre espace Silicium'. A polished segmented switch 'Se connecter' selected / 'Créer un compte'. Proper labeled fields 'E-mail ou identifiant', 'Mot de passe', password visibility icon, raised primary button 'Se connecter'. Bottom small 'Pas encore de compte ? Créer un compte'. Link 'Retour au site' and discreet locale switch. No social login, password reset promise, fake capabilities or invented trust badges. Form compact, accessible and calm.

pages.title: Inscription
pages.content: Desktop sign-up screen using exactly the same split layout and glass design as the login page. Left original Si logo, heading 'Vos projets commencent ici.' and a very subtle single glass tile, with extensive whitespace. Right frosted form title 'Créer votre compte', switch 'Se connecter' / 'Créer un compte' selected. Visible labeled inputs 'Prénom', 'Nom', 'Identifiant', 'Adresse e-mail', 'Mot de passe'. Primary button 'Créer mon compte'. Helpful concise password guidance, password visibility icon, errors not shown. Small existing-account link and 'Retour au site'. No social sign-up, billing card, paid subscription, fake testimonials or new product requirements.

pages.title: Vue d’ensemble
pages.content: Desktop account dashboard, active sidebar 'Vue d’ensemble'. Top page heading 'Votre espace de calcul', explanatory line, primary 'Nouveau projet'. Four compact frosted counters labeled 'Mes projets', 'En cours', 'Terminés', 'Machines en ligne', with illustrative values 6 / 1 / 4 / 2 and artifact label 'Maquette · données d’exemple'. Main wide panel 'Projets récents' is a readable list with recognizable workload icons and status badges: 'Scène atelier' / Rendu 3D / En cours / 68%; 'Corpus de recherche' / Documents / Terminé; 'Avis clients' / Traitement IA / Terminé; 'Archive de test' / SHA-256 / Terminé. Right narrow glass network card 'Mon réseau' with 2 connected machines, link 'Voir le réseau'; below useful quick actions 'Créer un projet', 'Découvrir les types de calcul', 'Installer le nœud'. A blue glass progress rail for ongoing project shows genuine app structure rather than vanity charts. No cost, revenue or performance claims.

pages.title: Mes projets
pages.content: Desktop project-list page, active sidebar 'Mes projets'. Heading 'Mes projets', brief description, raised 'Nouveau projet'. One main glass panel with inset search 'Rechercher un projet', status filters 'Tous', 'En cours', 'Terminés', 'Échoués', and small refresh. A clean spacious table with columns 'Projet', 'Type de calcul', 'État', 'Créé le', 'Actions'. Six fictional clearly labeled example rows covering Rendu 3D, Recherche documentaire, Traitement IA, Intégrité SHA-256, with restrained blue/green/amber badges, one in-progress bar, overflow buttons, download action only for completed items. First row 'Scène atelier', progress 68%; dates are examples. Clear pagination '1–6 sur 6'. Bottom contextual hint points to supported types. Keep table legible, no needless charts.

pages.title: Nouveau projet
pages.content: Desktop new-project page, active 'Mes projets'. Breadcrumb 'Mes projets / Nouveau projet', heading 'Que voulez-vous calculer ?'. A clear three-step progress header '1 Type de calcul', '2 Préparation', '3 Envoi'. Four compact selectable workload tiles 'Rendu 3D', 'Documents', 'Traitement IA', 'SHA-256', Rendu 3D selected. Main content a practical raytracer scene editor: central preview with a chrome sphere and a matte cube on a pale plane, subtle grid; small tools 'Objets', 'Caméra', 'Lumières', a right settings inspector with dimensions and object properties. Two modes 'Éditeur visuel' selected / 'Importer un .cfg'. Inset project-name input 'Scène atelier'. Lower section shows 'Récapitulatif' and blue 'Lancer le calcul'. Keep the editor the focus, explicit input/output PNG, no fictional realtime renderer promises, no new workload types. Small 'Maquette · scène d’exemple' caption. Strong useful UX instead of a long generic upload form.

pages.title: Détail d’un projet
pages.content: Desktop raytracing project detail/result page. Breadcrumb 'Mes projets / Scène atelier', clear title 'Scène atelier', status 'Terminé', workload 'Rendu 3D', primary 'Télécharger le PNG'. This is example data, clearly label small 'Maquette · données d’exemple'. A horizontal tactile process rail 'Préparé', 'Réparti', 'Vérifié', 'Assemblé' all completed, easy to scan. Dominant central result preview shows the same polished sphere and cube on a plane, a result image in a framed glass viewer with 'Résultat', 'Agrandir', dimensions 1024 × 768. Side panel summarizes 'Fichier source', 'Format', 'Fragments', 'Création', with no speed promises. Below clear tabs 'Résultat', 'Fragments', 'Traçabilité', 'Détails techniques', with compact fragment table partially visible. Link to Solana trace only as example identifier, never expose keys. Clear space for cancel action when running and result availability when complete, but show completed primary state.

pages.title: État du réseau
pages.content: Desktop network health page, active 'État du réseau'. Heading 'Le réseau, en un regard', description 'Consultez les machines et leur activité.', last-refresh info and button 'Actualiser'. Small artifact label 'Maquette · données d’exemple'. A large integrated glass topology canvas shows one coordinator connected to 3 compute machines and a verification role, restrained luminous blue lines with tiny status dots, not a decorative globe or fabricated global geographic locations. A side legend lists roles 'Coordination', 'Calcul', 'Vérification', and indicates 3 connected, 1 unavailable as example. Below topology, compact telemetry cards 'Machines disponibles', 'Calculs actifs', 'Versions à jour' and a practical machine list with 'Machine', 'Rôle', 'État', 'Version'. Proper 'Données indisponibles' example note in a small fallback inset, designed without flooding the UI. No fake high-throughput charts or uptime claims.

pages.title: Mes machines
pages.content: Desktop node-management page, active 'Mes machines'. Heading 'Vos machines participent au réseau', primary 'Installer Silicium Node'. Thin info banner explains 'Installez le nœud, puis connectez votre machine depuis l’application.' Three useful summary labels 'En ligne', 'À jour', 'À mettre à jour' using small example numbers. Two generous glass machine rows/cards 'Station de travail' and 'Portable de test', each shows status 'En ligne' / 'Hors ligne', version 'Version d’exemple', role 'Calcul', last seen, small action 'Voir les détails'. One quiet update chip 'Mise à jour disponible'. Right supporting installation panel shows Linux 'APT / DNF' and Windows supported, link 'Voir les instructions'. Do not invent remote destructive management or token fields. Meaningful tactile chip illustration, no vanity chart. Mark numbers 'Maquette · données d’exemple'.

pages.title: Types de calcul
pages.content: Desktop full-page supported-workloads reference page. Active sidebar 'Types de calcul'. Heading 'Choisissez le bon calcul.', subline 'Formats, résultats et exemples pour préparer votre projet.' A compact four-type tab strip with tactile icons, 'Rendu 3D' selected, 'Recherche documentaire', 'Traitement par IA', 'Intégrité SHA-256'. First detailed glass panel: title 'Rendu 3D', image showing sphere/cube scene; sections 'À fournir : scène .cfg ou éditeur visuel', 'Vous obtenez : une image PNG', a concise 4-stage description, 'Télécharger l’exemple' and raised 'Essayer ce calcul'. Below other three workload panels, each clear input/output summary and own example download: docs accept PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD with passages+page citations, AI accepts CSV/JSONL/text with CSV/JSONL results and 'Expérimental', SHA-256 returns a JSON report of file-part fingerprints. Important limits shown as calm in-context notes: participating machines read data; multipart hash is not the full-file SHA-256. No extra workload types or fictional benchmark results.

pages.title: Profil
pages.content: Desktop profile page. Breadcrumb 'Mon profil', heading 'Votre compte, vos accès.', side section navigation 'Informations', 'Sécurité', 'Portefeuille'. Left compact identity glass card with avatar 'EX', name 'Compte exemple', membership info no personal email. Central dominant labeled form 'Informations personnelles', fields 'Nom', 'Adresse e-mail', blue 'Enregistrer'. Below separate 'Changer le mot de passe' with current/new/confirm inputs, clear secondary action. Right narrow midnight frosted wallet card 'Portefeuille Solana', state 'Non associé', explanatory text, action 'Connecter Phantom'; small session-details card 'Session active' and proper 'Se déconnecter' action. Do not invent balances, payment settings, social providers, 2FA or dangerous account deletion. Maintain good hierarchy and form density, accessible contrast.

pages.title: Erreur
pages.content: Desktop 404/error page in same glass language and public navigation. A centered frosted panel with a tasteful fractured transparent blue tile illustration and large readable '404'. Headline 'Cette page est introuvable.' Short paragraph 'Le lien a peut-être changé. Retrouvez votre chemin depuis l’accueil ou votre espace.' Raised blue 'Retour à l’accueil', secondary 'Ouvrir mon espace'. Plenty of calm empty space, no fake terminal, sad robot, giant confusing 3D lettering or error stack. Small fallback variation note within artifact margin only 'Même structure pour une erreur de service, avec Réessayer'.

pages.title: Installation dev
pages.content: Full-page desktop installation screen, same exact structure and visual identity as stable installer but 'Linux' and 'Développement' selected, distribution 'Fedora / RHEL · DNF' selected. Title 'Connectez votre machine au réseau dev.' A clear compact amber-glass prerequisite panel at top 'Avant d’installer' with 1 'Activez WireGuard' and 2 'Installez le certificat fourni avec votre accès'. Expandable dark code block 'Certificat dev — une seule fois' shows exact commands 'sudo install -D -m 0644 ./silicium-dev-ca.crt.pem' then '/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/silicium-dev-ca.crt' then 'sudo update-ca-trust', styled as a multiline continuation with proper indentation. Main setup step '01 Ajouter le dépôt' with exact 'sudo curl -fsSL https://10.77.0.1:8443/downloads/rpm/silicium-node.repo' and '-o /etc/yum.repos.d/silicium-dev.repo'; step '02 Installer le nœud' 'sudo dnf makecache' and 'sudo dnf install silicium-node'. Each code block has 'Copier'. Small note 'Un seul canal par machine'. Troubleshooting panel 'Le paquet est introuvable ?' with 'dnf repolist --enabled' and 'dnf repoquery --repo=silicium-dev silicium-node'. No insecure curl -k, no disabling GPG or TLS, no admin SSH/private-key instructions. Make ordering and command readability excellent.

pages.title: Accueil mobile
pages.content: A single straight-on mobile web screenshot, 390px-wide viewport composed tall, no device frame. Reflow the master homepage naturally for touch. Compact floating glass top bar logo 'Silicium', FR and menu button; do not cram desktop nav. Hero headline 'Vos calculs, à une autre échelle.', short text, full-width raised blue 'Lancer un calcul' and secondary 'Explorer les usages'. Below a proportional transparent compute-tile sculpture, not larger than the hero copy. Stacked or two-column compact workload choices with clear touch targets and four types. Process becomes vertical numbered steps. Contribution CTA and footer lower. Keep readable 16px body, 44px touch targets, no horizontal overflow. Preserve beautiful highlights, shadows and subtle blur on mobile, prioritize legibility. No desktop sidebar squeezed down.

pages.title: Installation mobile
pages.content: One straight-on mobile website mockup 390px wide, tall, no phone frame. Same design as desktop installer reflowed properly. Compact glass public nav. Heading 'Installer Silicium Node'. Touch-sized switches 'Linux / Windows', 'Stable / Dev', 'APT / DNF' with DNF selected, wrapping labels sensibly. Step 01 'Ajouter le dépôt' dark blue readable monospace command panel with top-right 'Copier', long URL displayed across intentional continued lines inside the panel, not clipped. Real example URL 'https://vps-910c1dbc.vps.ovh.net/downloads/rpm/silicium-node.repo'. Step02 'Installer le nœud', exact commands 'sudo dnf makecache', 'sudo dnf install silicium-node'. Next update block 'sudo dnf upgrade silicium-node'. Note 'Paquets et index signés'. A contextual Dev prereq collapsed panel mentions WireGuard and certificat, no insecure shortcuts. Sticky bottom quiet action 'Ouvrir mon espace' only if useful. 16px body and generous touch targets, no tiny desktop text, no overflow.

pages.title: Projet mobile
pages.content: One straight-on mobile web app mockup 390px wide, tall, no phone device frame. Same glossy frosted app design with mobile header original Si logo, breadcrumb back 'Mes projets', profile avatar, no desktop sidebar. Page title 'Scène atelier', status 'Terminé', small 'Maquette · données d’exemple'. Four-stage progress compressed into clear numbered connected checkmarks. A large full-width result image of sphere and cube, button 'Télécharger le PNG' directly beneath. Proper touch-sized tab strip 'Résultat', 'Fragments', 'Trace', technical details as collapsed sections below. Compact info rows for format and fragments; avoid a tiny horizontal table. Floating frosted bottom navigation with labeled items 'Accueil', 'Projets' selected, 'Machines', 'Réseau', no overflow, enough bottom padding so it does not cover content. Strong contrast, useful information first, 44px targets, clear safe-area spacing.

notes: Latest user correction: previous mockups too busy; use far fewer effects, calm background and open layouts.
New authentic logo supplied through local Downloads: Lille_Silicium_DistributedNetwork.png.
All canonical pages covered, aliases share target layouts.
Maintain actual forms, four workload types and working APT/DNF commands.
Raster code text is indicative; implementation must use exact repositoryCommands output.
No frontend implementation changes before the revised mockup set is complete.

assets.role: authentic new logo supplied in Downloads

implementation.tests: No test suites added or run during this redesign
